scope: Isolated local copy; synthetic authentication; no production mutations or mail

checks.name: Editor requires staff authentication
Existing staff authentication endpoint grants the synthetic account a real session
1–2. Open the visual editor and actual Home page
Sidebar tools, properties rail and the website canvas share one window
3–4. Click a real heading and edit text directly on the page
Undo and redo restore the inline text change
5. Change the heading font to Sora
6. Change the heading size
7. Change text color through the color control
8. Apply a text gradient and its direction
9. Change text opacity
Desktop, tablet and mobile preview work; mobile size does not change desktop
10. Select an existing image with a bounding box and eight resize handles
11. Drag image left, right, up and down with real pointer gestures
12. Resize an image by dragging its actual corner handle
13. Replace the image using the website media library
14. Add a real section and edit its heading on the canvas
15. Move the section up in the actual page
Published Home persists text, font, size, gradient, opacity and replacement image
Published Home survives a clean visitor reload
16. Create an actual website page with a clean URL
17. Edit the newly created page directly
18. Save the page and show the saved status
19. Preview the actual page as a visitor
20. Publish the new page through the authenticated CMS
21. Open the real clean public page URL
22. Verify persisted public content and styles after reload
Public custom-page logo returns to the actual Home page
Unpublish withdraws the public page
Deleting an actual page requires confirmation
Cancel preserves the page
Confirmed deletion returns to Home
Editor keeps its four tools accessible on a phone width
No uncaught browser exceptions
